subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should maintainers sponsor a narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery patch now, or hold that delivery change for the broader durable final fallback contract while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94833 handles Codex lane release?
rationale: Current main still has a concrete WhatsApp suppression bug, but the previous narrow PR is closed unmerged and the open maintainer issue frames the permanent behavior as a cross-channel contract choice.

options.title: Ship Narrow WhatsApp Patch
options.body: Revive or replace the focused WhatsApp final `isError` delivery fix, then keep broader conformance and observability work on the maintainer-owned contract issue.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Contract
options.body: Do not reopen a WhatsApp-only patch and instead resolve this issue only when the cross-channel durable final fallback contract lands.

options.title: Only Land Codex Lane Release
options.body: Treat the remaining Codex lane-release PR as sufficient for now, accepting that final WhatsApp fallback delivery stays unresolved until a later report or design decision.

recommendation.title: Ship Narrow WhatsApp Patch
recommendation.body: Revive or replace the focused WhatsApp final `isError` delivery fix, then keep broader conformance and observability work on the maintainer-owned contract issue.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to this issue and owns the related maintainer issue that decides durable final fallback semantics.
